deviations.why: evaluation/pipeline.py builds models from KNOWN_CLASS while training uses list(CLASS_TO_INDEX.keys()); the upstream literal is inconsistent with CLASS_TO_INDEX and would index a different class-embedding row at evaluation
deviations.affects_math: only evaluation-side embedding lookup alignment; training-time index order is unchanged

deviations.what: the six-class vocabulary keeps pedestrian although TRAIN/VAL observe {building, car, ground, pole, vegetation} only (pedestrian = 29 declared objects, manifest places them in TEST)
deviations.why: dropping a declared class would silently change the vocabulary; its class-embedding row simply receives no gradient
deviations.affects_math: no gradient for that row; disclosed in every report

deviations.what: --pmc_prob 0.5 is registered unchanged but is a structural no-op on NPM3D
deviations.why: every NPM3D cell has 0 compass neighbours (direction/_summary.json neighbour_edges = 0); probe measured 0/4 relocations
deviations.affects_math: no relocation can occur; recipe value kept as published

recipe.scale_warning: NPM3D TRAIN is small (120 poses). Step counts above are the whole of formal training; no epoch or batch is enlarged, and no extra data is added.

selection.test: TEST is closed during training (MP_NO_TEST=1); evaluation/pipeline.py never constructs TEST data. Exactly one TEST read after VAL freeze, in the SCAR/TEST stage, guarded by meta/TEST_READ_DONE.
